# NeuralNexus repo secrets
#
# Create each of these in:
#   GitHub > neuralnexus > Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions
#
#   Tab : Repository secrets
#   Type: Secrets
#
# Copy each NAME (column 1) and paste in a value.
# None are required for the build (stubs are baked in at build time),
# but each is required for its feature at runtime.
#
# NOTE on the database: the app now uses SQLite, so there is no
# DATABASE_URL to set. The DB file lives on the `nn-sqlite` volume
# at /data/dev.db inside the container (see .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml).

# -- required for NextAuth sign-in ------------------------------
# Must stay the same across deploys, otherwise existing sign-in
# sessions become invalid on the next deploy.
#   NEXTAUTH_SECRET

# GitHub App credentials (NextAuth provider). Create one at
#   github.com/settings/developers > New OAuth App (or GitHub App)
# then paste in:
#   GITHUB_ID      (Client ID)
#   GITHUB_SECRET  (Client secret)
